# Theme gallery

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-examples.js. Edit that file, then run `npm run examples`. -->

Pick a theme with `theme=<name>` (or `theme:` in the GitHub Action). Every theme works with
every layout.

Every design comes in a **light and a dark variant** that share their colours, art and font, so
they belong together when your card follows GitHub's light and dark mode. In the Action, set
`dark-theme: match` to use both (see the
[README](../README.md#match-githubs-light-and-dark-mode)); the link builder does it by default.

## Artistic themes

Each artistic theme pairs a palette with a background [art style](#art-styles), and some add a
matching font or a neon glow (dark variants only). The art is generated from your username, so
your card's starfield or contour map is unique to you. Animations are subtle and switch off for
people who prefer reduced motion.

`light` is the same as `default`. `auto` switches between `default` and `dark` inside a single
image, following the viewer's operating system rather than their GitHub setting:

<img src="../assets/examples/theme-auto.svg" alt="auto theme" width="300">

## Art styles

Add `art=<style>` to put any art style on any theme, for example
`theme=dracula&art=starfield`. Use `art=none` to switch off the art of an artistic theme.
The art takes its colours from the theme's accent and title colours, so it also follows
`accent_color` and the `auto` theme. Previews below use the `dark` theme.

| Style           | Description                                                            | Preview                                                                                  |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `starfield`     | A night sky of twinkling stars and sparkles, unique to every username. | <img src="../assets/examples/art-starfield.svg" alt="starfield art" width="300">         |
| `constellation` | Stars joined into a constellation that draws itself in.                | <img src="../assets/examples/art-constellation.svg" alt="constellation art" width="300"> |
| `aurora`        | Soft, drifting bands of northern lights.                               | <img src="../assets/examples/art-aurora.svg" alt="aurora art" width="300">               |
| `synthwave`     | A striped retro sun over a neon perspective grid.                      | <img src="../assets/examples/art-synthwave.svg" alt="synthwave art" width="300">         |
| `waves`         | Layered ocean waves rolling along the bottom edge.                     | <img src="../assets/examples/art-waves.svg" alt="waves art" width="300">                 |
| `topography`    | Hand-drawn contour lines, like a hiking map.                           | <img src="../assets/examples/art-topography.svg" alt="topography art" width="300">       |
| `blueprint`     | Engineering grid paper with corner crop marks.                         | <img src="../assets/examples/art-blueprint.svg" alt="blueprint art" width="300">         |
| `halftone`      | Pop-art halftone dots fading in from a corner.                         | <img src="../assets/examples/art-halftone.svg" alt="halftone art" width="300">           |
| `scanlines`     | CRT scanlines, a vignette and a slow refresh beam.                     | <img src="../assets/examples/art-scanlines.svg" alt="scanlines art" width="300">         |
| `grain`         | Paper grain and a warm vignette, like an old print.                    | <img src="../assets/examples/art-grain.svg" alt="grain art" width="300">                 |
| `bokeh`         | Blurred, floating circles of light.                                    | <img src="../assets/examples/art-bokeh.svg" alt="bokeh art" width="300">                 |
| `sakura`        | Cherry blossom petals swaying in the breeze.                           | <img src="../assets/examples/art-sakura.svg" alt="sakura art" width="300">               |

## Make it your own

Any theme can be tweaked with colour overrides (hex, with or without `#`):

| Parameter      | Colours                             |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `bg_color`     | Card background (removes gradients) |
| `border_color` | Card border                         |
| `title_color`  | Title and big numbers               |
| `text_color`   | Main text                           |
| `muted_color`  | Labels and secondary text           |
| `accent_color` | Stars, highlights and art           |
| `track_color`  | Empty part of bars and rings        |

```md
![GitHub stars](https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT.vercel.app/api/stars?username=octocat&theme=nord&art=topography&accent_color=ff6b6b)
```

Want a theme or art style added? Open a [theme request](https://github.com/iiogurt/Awesome-Git-Stats/issues/new?template=theme_request.yml).
